question: Six teams named P, Q, R, S, T and U won tournaments in different months of the same year, viz. January, February, March, April, May and June. R won the tournament in January. Q won in the month immediately before U. P won the tournament in the month immediately before S. Exactly two teams won the tournaments between the months of R and S. In which month did T win the tournament?
solution:
Given: Six teams named P, Q, R, S, T and U won tournaments in different months of the same year, viz. January, February, March, April, May and June.

1) R won the tournament in January.

2) Exactly two teams won the tournaments between the months of R and S.

3) P won the tournament in the month immediately before S.
